title: Arc 1, Chapter 2: The City of Sparks
subtitle: Little Stewards D&D playthrough summary and canon record
summary: The party establishes itself in Veylathar, explores the city's magical infrastructure, uncovers the first hints of political unrest, and Fiona undergoes a life-changing transformation.
majorOutcome: The Wayward Flame becomes the party's home, Frederick becomes a friend, Queen Flower's pendant reacts to the Luminary Dome, and Fiona becomes a Paladin of Aureth.

sections.heading: The Wayward Flame
sections.bodyHtml:
Kara Emberfall welcomes the party after the butcher vouches for them. Anja Willowbark serves Flameheart Ale and magical meals infused with druidic energy.

Canon: Anja unknowingly imbues her food and Flameheart Ale with druidic magic.

sections.heading: Kara's Map
sections.bodyHtml: Kara explains the city and marks the Ethereum Academy, Academy of Antiquities, Crucible District, Academy of Sparks, Council of Sparks, and Central Market with its towering blimp cargo spires.

sections.heading: Academy of Sparks
sections.bodyHtml:
• The Academy is secretly the city's magical rail hub.
  • Conductors wear enchanted boots that channel fire magic.
  • Special Sparks power trains while the match burns.
  • Employee doors are keyed to the conductor boots.
  • The party notices face-changing putty used by local children.

sections.heading: Frederick
sections.bodyHtml: The party befriends Frederick, a nervous young gnome conductor. Rather than steal from him, they encourage him. He rewards them with a free guided train tour.

sections.heading: Tour of Veylathar
sections.bodyHtml:
• Crucible District's industrial forges.
  • Council of Sparks and city government.
  • Luminary Dome where Queen Flower's pendant mysteriously rises toward the museum.
  • Ethereum Academy where Dr. Fizzlebig studies Fiona's holy transformation.

sections.heading: Fiona's Transformation
sections.bodyHtml:
BeforeAfter
WarlockPaladin of Aureth
Demonic swordGolden holy blade
Dark magicHealing and radiant power

sections.heading: Academy of Antiquities
sections.bodyHtml: Queen Flower and Sertraline investigate the pendant. Outside they overhear citizens criticizing the Queen Regent, introducing the campaign's first political conflict.

sections.heading: Hunting Excursion
sections.bodyHtml: Meanwhile, Golo learns a deer call from hunters. He accidentally wounds a fawn, allowing Fiona to perform her first miraculous healing.

sections.heading: Downtime
sections.bodyHtml: The venison gathered from the hunt pays for two weeks of lodging and meals at the Wayward Flame, establishing the campaign's downtime rhythm.

sections.heading: Permanent Canon
sections.bodyHtml:
• Fiona is now a Paladin of Aureth.
  • Frederick becomes a recurring ally.
  • The Academy of Sparks and magical railway are understood.
  • Queen Flower's pendant is connected to the Luminary Dome.
  • Political dissatisfaction with the Queen Regent has begun.
  • The party has two weeks of paid room and board.
